description:
Give your dry skin the love it deserves with the Urea Skin & Heel Repair Kit – A Clinically Proven solution for Deep Hydration from Head to Heel!  
✨ Why Urea? 
Urea is a key component of the skin’s Natural Moisturizing Factor (NMF), locking in moisture 💦, exfoliating dead skin cells 🧽, and strengthening the skin barrier 🛡️ for deep, long-lasting hydration.

✨What’s Inside? 
✅ 20% Urea Foot Roll On  – A mess-free roll-on that exfoliates, nourishes & repairs cracked, rough heels 👣 with 20% Urea, Lactic Acid & Vitamin E.
✅10% Urea Lotion  – A lightweight, non-greasy formula with Shea, Mango & Kokum Butters  that deeply moisturizes and is clinically proven to hydrate dry, itchy skin for up to 48 hours ⏳.

💫 Transform your Heels, Knees & Elbows with this Powerful Duo!

Step 1: Take a generous amount of lotion and massage onto your hands and feet, until absorbed
Step 2: Roll on the product on to clean and dry feet, wait until absorbed.
